ai_scoring_2026_04_23_bugs: Gaussian _dim_score with sigma=half_range punished any value outside optimal; elbow 152 vs target 165-180 returned ~3/100 when a coach would grade it ~70.

score_components substituted 160/95/18 defaults when a primitive was Low Confidence, shipping 'Strength: leg load solid' copy next to an Elbow N/A card. (already fixed earlier this session; no regression.)
shooting_side='auto' misclassified the 13.7s clip -> release_frame landed at frame 63 -> all metrics collapsed to Low Confidence -> UI showed 'We could not analyse this clip'.
Gemini enrichment ran fire-and-forget AFTER status=completed, so the client saw rule-based copy until a second poll arrived (and often never, because the overlay wasn't re-polled).
get_shot_feedback returned the fallback ShotFeedbackOutput on failure, echoing the rule-based number; downstream couldn't tell 'AI graded' from 'AI was unavailable'.
ai_scoring_2026_04_23_changes: metrics.py _dim_score rewritten to piecewise: optimal=100, good=70-100 linear, reasonable=30-70, then gentle decay to 0. normative_ranges.json gained good_range for elbow/knee/wrist.
output_schemas.py ShotFeedbackOutput gained ai_overall_score + ai_score_rationale fields; prompt_builders.py rewritten so Gemini grades holistically (attempted shot with one weak axis -> 60-80).
llm_router.get_shot_feedback now returns (output, is_fallback). mvp_job_service._enrich_with_gemini overrides overall_score when AI grades, preserves rule_based_score, sets ai_scored flag honestly.

_process_video_job_async awaits Gemini within SHOOTRZ_AI_TIMEOUT_S (default 10s) via asyncio.to_thread BEFORE marking status=completed. Supabase persist stays fire-and-forget. test_poll_does_not_block covers this path.

pipeline.py: auto-side retry - when shooting_side='auto' AND pose_overall_confidence>0.6 AND all primitives Low Confidence, re-run angle/shot/metric chain on the opposite side. Fixes the 13.7s 'We could not analyse this clip' case.

ai_scoring_2026_04_23_real_clip_after.overall_score_when_gemini_ok: 70-85 expected per the new prompt rubric (hits rate-limit on free tier; fallback returns rule_based_score=69)
ai_scoring_2026_04_23_real_clip_after.note: The rule-based score jumped 13 -> 69 purely from the softer _dim_score curve; Gemini will typically push it to 70-85 when the free-tier quota hasn't been exhausted for the day.

angle_fix_2026_04_23_bugs: Metric values averaged over a rigid release+/-3 window so a single low-vis frame turned the whole metric N/A.
_dim_score compared the average (often a near-idle angle) against biomechanical peak targets, yielding 0/100 even when the true peak was near-optimal.

score_components substituted elbow=160 / knee=95 / wrist=18 defaults when the primitive was Low Confidence, producing misleading 'Strength: leg load looks solid (71/100)' copy next to an Elbow N/A card.
wrist_follow_through had no entry in normative_ranges.json so its sub-score relied on a code fallback.
save_overlay_video: true in mvp_config.yaml was ignored by the async job path (only SHOOTRZ_SAVE_OVERLAY env triggered rendering).
annotate_video indexed pose_results[frame_idx] by list position while the list was stride-sampled, mis-aligning the skeleton by a growing offset.
angle_fix_2026_04_23_changes: metrics.py: peak-in-window selection (elbow max / knee min / wrist release+end), MIN_JOINT_CONF_FOR_METRIC=0.50, selected_frame emitted per metric.
metrics.py: low_confidence_threshold 0.4 -> 0.5; deleted 160/95/18 substitutions; components value=null when primitive is Low Confidence.
pipeline.py: flips status to completed_low_quality when every primitive fails the confidence gate.
mvp_config.yaml: output.save_overlay_video: true; mvp_job_service._resolve_save_overlay combines env + YAML.
utils/video_annotator.py rewritten: dict-indexed pose lookup + linear interpolation + phase ribbon + angle HUD + release/crouch/end/selected_frame markers.
contracts/mvp.py: MVPMetric.selected_frame, MVPScoreComponent.value Optional, MVPResultResponse.pose_overall_confidence surfaced.
MVPAnalysisScreen: tracking-quality chip driven by pose_overall_confidence; Low-Confidence metrics render '--' N/A instead of '0.0 degrees'.

angle_fix_2026_04_23_real_clip_after.interpretation: Score 13 is legitimately low: the shooter's knee bend (54 deg) is far from the 100-120 deg biomechanical target. Elbow at release (163 deg) and wrist follow-through (26 deg) are in the Good zone and now measured at the correct peak frames.

event_loop_fix_2026_04_23_bug: Client saw 'AxiosError: timeout of 30000ms exceeded' on GET /api/mvp/result/<job>. Root cause: _process_video_job_async called _enrich_with_gemini (sync 2-30s HTTP) and _save_to_supabase (sync 1-5s HTTP) INLINE in the event loop. During those 20-40s windows every concurrent GET poll stalled until the 30s axios timeout tripped.
event_loop_fix_2026_04_23_change: Gemini + Supabase now run in asyncio.create_task spawning an async helper that uses asyncio.to_thread. _build_completed_payload / _maybe_build_overlay / _preflight_video also moved to threads. Status is set to 'completed' BEFORE enrichment starts, so polls return the full result immediately and enrichment merely refines feedback copy in the background.
event_loop_fix_2026_04_23_regression_tes: backend/tests/test_poll_does_not_block.py — stubs Gemini (6s sleep) + Supabase (2s sleep), drives analyze + poll via TestClient, asserts every poll returns in <1s.
pose_fix_2026_04_23_bug: pose_2d.py silently returned (0.5, 0.5, conf=0.5) landmarks for every frame whenever MediaPipe failed to initialise. On this machine MediaPipe failed to load because mediapipe==0.10.14 needs protobuf>=5, installed was 4.25. Result: every real analysis shipped 0 degree angles and a nonsense 0/100 or 26/100 score to the app (screens: 'YOUR SHOT SCORE 0 POOR').
pose_fix_2026_04_23_changes: (1) protobuf>=5.27 pinned in requirements.txt; uninstalled rogue tensorflow 2.21 from venv. (2) pose_2d.py narrows the exception and re-raises unless SHOOTRZ_POSE_FALLBACK=1 (tests only). (3) pipeline.py rejects all-identical-keypoint runs as completed_low_quality with an actionable message. (4) Visibility gate lifted 0.30 -> 0.40. (5) tests/test_real_clip_pose.py guards the regression on a real clip.
